   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  AUGUST 11, 2025

Chair Leon called the meeting to order at 6:00 p.m. Responding to roll call were Chair Leon, Vice Chair
Ang, Commissioner Sanchez, Commissioner Garcia and Commissioner Lopez. Also present was Alex
Ocegueda, Office Assistant III, Rosalee Santa Ana, Senior Management Analyst and Patti Hoskins,
Public Safety Commissioner.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Chair Leon made the motion and Commissioner Garcia seconded to approve the minutes for July 21,
2025. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

First Responders Luncheon

Mrs. Ocegueda asked Commissioners if they wished to continue with the placemat artwork for the
event. All Commissioners agreed to continue with Chair Leon, Commissioner Sanchez and
Commission Garcia all volunteering to reach out to schools. Mrs. Ocegueda stated she will order the
mats to be distributed at the next meeting. Chair Leon stated she would put together a letter explaining
the project and send it to Mrs. Ocegueda to print on city letterhead to accompany the placemat packet
when being dropped off at the schools by commissioners. Mrs. Ocegueda asked Commissioners what
restaurants they would like her to obtain food quotes from for the event. Mr. Rosewoods, Angie’s
Mexican Food, and Ho Ho China were all suggested. Commissioner Sanchez requested there be
background music playing during the event. Commissioner Sanchez stated he already reached out to
Costco about sponsorship and requested an updated version of the Sponsorship letter he can provide
them with to obtain the sponsorship. Mrs. Ocegueda stated she will update the letter and send it to all
commissioners for their use.

Business Spotlight

Ms. Santa Ana showed the “Keeping It Norwalk” Campaign, the July Burger Spots edition video to
Commissioners. Chair Leon asked if staff could add either the spotlight videos themselves or a link to
them next to each month when the list of winners is posted at the end of the year so residents can
easily view them without having to do extensive searches. Ms. Santa Ana stated she’ll have staff look
into providing easier website navigation to past winners/videos.

New Social Media Series

Mrs. Ocegueda reported that staff are still working on a series name and logo. She also informed
Commissioners that the Hargitt House Museum will be the first video in this series with staff aiming to
have it ready for posting in early 2026.
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Community Promotion Commission
August 11, 2025

Communications and Public Affairs Analytics

Ms. Santa Ana provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and the city’s
overall reach across all outreach platforms for the last month showing an increase in key metrics.

STAFF COMMENTS:

Mrs. Ocegueda provided updated Mission and Vision Statements based on Commissioner’s feedback
at the last meeting. Commissioners reviewed and approved statements. Mrs. Ocegueda gave
Commissioners an update on their merchandise survey efforts; 565 surveys were obtained with one
more concert event left to obtain the necessary 600 survey count. Commissioners Garcia and Lopez
both confirmed they’ll be assisting at the last concert.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Commissioner Lopez was welcomed and stated she is excited to join the commission and looks forward
to working with everyone. Commissioner Sanchez provided updates on the 40th Annual Arturo Sanchez
Sr. Halloween Parade; history of the parade in pictures and personal family items will be featured in
the Mary Paxon Art Gallery. Vice Chair Ang, Commissioner Garcia and Commissioner Lopez all stated
they will be able to assist in the announcement duties for the parade. Vice Chair Ang informed the
Commission of the passing of Joe Gomez, a bandmate who was born and raised in Norwalk.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:29p.m.

_____________________________

Armida Leon, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
